thread:
maria_sales: FYI — Stratosphere wants to start a 6-week pilot but hit two blockers: they require IP allowlist + confirmation we can support customer-managed KMS. Legal also flagged a data residency Q in the vendor questionnaire. Need quick internal alignment.
hao_se: Quick clarifying Q: are they okay with hosted if we enable allowlist and restrict egress? Or do they absolutely need private deployment?
omar_csm: Customer message: "Hosted is fine if allowlist + SOC2 + KMS option. Pricing for a short pilot will determine signoff." They've attached the completed questionnaire PDF.
nina_security: I'll need to review their questionnaire but initial ask: if they want BYO-KMS we need a SOC2 mapping for key management and a KMS integration plan. Also confirm if their data is in-scope for GDPR special categories.
tom_eng: From infra side we can provision an allowlist-restricted hosted endpoint and expose a BYO-KMS path (with caveats). BYO-KMS requires an onboarding ticket + ephemeral replay testing. Timeline: enable allowlist same day; KMS integration ~5 business days.
ivy_revops: Pricing: short pilot (6 weeks, high throughput) falls into enterprise pilot pricing. I can approve a one-off pilot rate with exec sign-off. Need a one-paragraph business rationale and expected ARR conversion to justify discount.
maria_sales: I'll run the exec bridge tomorrow 9am PT. Need a short note for Jordan (VP) with revenue impact + risk of losing deal if we delay. Ivy, can you draft?
ivy_revops: Drafting now 4dd. Proposed bullets: 1) Pilot revenue potential: $80k ARR (estimate) 2) Competitive threat: rival vendor already in pilot with their ML team 3) Speed reduces churn and increases chance of enterprise deal. Approve provisional 15% pilot discount pending legal review.
hao_se: Technical plan to propose on bridge: A) Provide IP ranges and allowlist form B) Offer hosted-with-allowlist + reserved burst capacity C) If customer rejects egress -> propose Dedicated with timeline.
ops-bot: scheduled-change: allowlist-enabled -> canary rollout by @tom_eng at 3099005400

tom_eng: Canary started. Watchlist added to perf dashboard.
omar_csm: Sent IP ranges and SOC2 summary link to Stratosphere. Asked them to confirm whether BYO-KMS is required or optional.
maria_sales: Also asked them to sign and return signed allowlist form before bridge. They said legal wants pricing in writing first.
ivy_revops: I posted a provisional pricing email template here. Key line: "15% pilot discount for 6-week trial, subject to standard SOW and data residency terms." Copied legal.
nina_security: Noted two potential redlines on questionnaire: retention period >90 days and cross-border transfer clause. If they insist on >90 days retention, legal addendum required.
hao_se: I'll prepare a VPC peering timeline (7-10 days) as fallback and include playbook for KV cache handling during peering.
maria_sales: Jordan @jordan_sales please approve the pilot discount so we can email pricing before the bridge. This is time-sensitive.
jordan_sales: +1 provisional approve for 15% pilot discount. Legal to review T&Cs.
omar_csm: Customer confirmed they'll sign allowlist once pricing is emailed. Also asked for SOC2 PDF copy (we shared a redacted summary).
ivy_revops: Sent pricing to customer and legal. Included note: discount expires if contract not executed within 14 days.
ops-bot: alert: canary completed at 3099006000, rollout health: green.
tom_eng: KMS onboarding ticket created: KMS-2942. ETA 5 business days pending customer key material.
nina_security: I'll review their redacted questionnaire and respond with required clarifications.
maria_sales: Thanks all. Bridge agenda: confirm BYO-KMS requirement, confirm pricing and sign allowlist form, confirm data classification. Keep updates brief in this thread.
omar_csm: Adding meeting minutes to the customer folder after bridge. Will tag for follow-ups.
ivy_revops: Once legal signs off I'll convert provisional pricing to formal SOW.
hao_se: If we get a firm BYO-KMS ask, we should prepare a short SSO/KMS ops runbook for the customer to accelerate onboarding.
maria_sales: Copy. If anything changes before 9am PT ping me. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
